messages:
ashley_cs: @raj FYI Auric Rewards asked if we can onboard a hybrid multi-model setup (13B distill + 70B fallback) before their Q2 pilot. They flagged PHI-like receipt fields and want HSM-backed keys for logs. Can we scope this?

raj_engineer: thanks. quick q — do they need both models live at launch or can the 70B be a cold fallback? also what's their SLO for critical flows? @liang any perf back-of-envelope?

liang_ml: 13B quantized runs ~60ms p50 on A100 with batching tuned. 70B without heavy optimization is ~300-400ms p50. Cold fallback could be >1s. We can improve with KV caching + Triton kernels but cost rises.

margo_pmo: timeline: they want a canary in ~3 weeks. Renewal is end of quarter so delay increases churn risk. @ashley_cs can you confirm data residency (EU/US) and whether receipts include PHI/PCI?

ashley_cs: They capture user receipts (addresses + small health notes) — legal thinks PHI-adjacent. They prefer on-prem HSM for customer keys. Also asked for per-request token cost breakdown in Console.

deploy-bot: Note: Dedicated capacity request template emailed to auric@auric.ai (ticket #CS-1229).

raj_engineer: work items to action: 1) safety/regression evals 2) latency + load tests 3) HSM/KMS integration plan 4) canary rollout policy + rollback conditions. I'll draft runbook and infra ticket.

liang_ml: For evals propose: A) 1k labeled prompt pairs for regression vs current baseline B) red-team suite from Auric + internal edge cases C) 150 rps throughput sim at 1k token avg to validate batching. I can seed prompts but need anonymized sample data.

ashley_cs: I will request Auric upload 500 anonymized receipt samples to the secure intake form (no PHI). I'll CC legal and compliance. ETA: EOD Friday.

margo_pmo: Add enablement: 1-hour customer workshop + internal runbook handoff. Who will present model/perf tradeoffs? @liang or @raj?

liang_ml: I can handle the customer workshop on model tradeoffs, quantization, and perf expectations. @raj can cover deployment and operational controls.

raj_engineer: Canary plan draft: 5% traffic to 70B, auto rollback if >2% error rate or latency >600ms p95 for 10 minutes. Need feature-flag toggle and metrics dashboard.

ashley_cs: Pricing ask from Auric: want a hybrid billing estimate (per-token hosted + reserved capacity for fallback). Finance needs usage assumptions. This is tied to renewal decision.

sam_finance: I can put together a 90-day estimate. Please provide expected token volume and percent hitting fallback model.

ashley_cs: I'll confirm volumes — preliminary estimate ~1.2M tokens/month and fallback usage ~8-12% depending on load.

liang_ml: note: quantization can slightly change model behavior; include regression evals against quantized artifacts. Also test with prefix KV caching toggled.

raj_engineer: I'll open infra ticket for Dedicated pool: request 2x A100s for canary capacity. Creating INF-889 and linking CS-1229.

ashley_cs: Thanks team. I'll update Auric, book the workshop for next Wed, and mark this as high priority for renewal. tagging thread as onboarding-critical :exclamation: 

cs-bot: Thread archived to CS onboarding tracker (CS-1229).
